_doc: Readable notes of the third block (Pell's Crossing's school, fire station and bank; also pool buildings for random towns, so no note names its town): the school (the failed evacuation point), the volunteer fire station and the Savings & Loan. Each tells its building's story and points the way through (items: items/town2.json note_<id>).

defs.title: Cordon Notice No. 7
defs.author: Cordon Command, Tamsin Valley
defs.body:
EVACUATION ASSEMBLY POINT — CONSOLIDATED SCHOOL

Residents north of the highway report to the school gymnasium with ONE bag per person and photo identification.
All persons will be screened by Cordon Medical before boarding.
Persons showing symptoms will travel separately.
Buses depart 0900.

Pasted across it, a second strip: ASSEMBLY POINT CLOSED — DO NOT APPROACH.

defs.title: Evacuation Register
defs.author: Agnes Whitlow, Principal
defs.body:
Day 1. 212 signed in. Gym full by noon. Bus came at nine, took forty, never came back.
Day 2. Screening all night. Lt. Okonkwo moves the ones with the cough to my nurse's office, then down to the boiler room 'for isolation'. She keeps the boiler room key and I keep a copy in my desk because I am still the principal of this building.
Day 3. Nine in the boiler room. They have stopped asking for water.
Day 3, night. Something wrong in the gym. The soldiers chained the gym doors from the hall. From the HALL. There are children in there.
Day 4. I am going up to the lights catwalk with the keys. If I can open the doors from above I will.

defs.title: Written on the Classroom Board
defs.author: a child
defs.body:
(In careful capitals under the times tables:)
MRS DALE SAYS WE ARE GOING ON A BUS TRIP.
WE ARE NOT ALOUD IN THE GYM AT NIGHT.
THE NURSE ROOM DOOR IS LOCKD.
(Lower down, smaller, crossed out and written again:)
the man under the bleachers is not asleep

defs.title: Isolation Orders
defs.author: Lt. M. Okonkwo, Cordon Medical
defs.body:
ISOLATION — SCHOOL ASSEMBLY POINT

Symptomatic persons are to be held in the boiler room (cellar) pending transport. Antifungal stock (32 courses) is held in the isolation store; issue on my signature only.
No one is to enter the gymnasium after 2200.

Handwritten at the bottom, the pen dug in: Transport is not coming. Issued all I could. I am staying down here with them. Do not open this door.

defs.title: Station Run Log
defs.author: Chief Hal Brekke
defs.body:
Run 41. Structure fire, out on the farm road. Family wouldn't come out. Neither would whatever was in the barn.
Run 42. Cordon wants the engine for the checkpoint. Told them it doesn't start. It starts.
Run 43. Pruitt bitten pulling a woman out of a house on the river road. Put him in the dorm. Bunk 3.
Run 44. Pruitt bit Sorensen. Moved both to the bay. Locked the dorm.
No run 45. I'm staying with my crew. Keys are where the boys keep them, up the tower. Somebody slide down the pole and close the bay doors behind me.

defs.title: Duty Board
defs.author: Volunteer Fire Co. No. 2
defs.body:
ON CALL THIS WEEK
Engine 1: Brekke (chief), Pruitt, Sorensen, Haag
Tower / lookout: Haag
HOSE TOWER KEYS HANG ON THE LOOKOUT HOOK — PUT THEM BACK

Chalked over it: HAAG STILL UP THERE. DON'T.

defs.title: Disbursement Notice
defs.author: Tamsin Valley Savings & Loan
defs.body:
CORDON RELOCATION STIPEND
Paid at this branch, 9am to 3pm, on presentation of photo identification and Cordon screening card.
$100 per adult, $50 per child, in cash or Program scrip.
The branch will close at 3pm PROMPTLY.

Someone has written underneath: the line goes to the river. what happens at 3

defs.title: Manager's Ledger
defs.author: Ruth Calloway, Branch Manager
defs.body:
Paid out 1,840 to 2:55pm. Shut the doors at three with the line still outside. They came in through the staff room window.
Sgt. Vance, Dale and I are going into the vault with the stipend cash. The time lock would hold us until eight tomorrow, so I have set it to manual: we can let ourselves out. Combination on the slip in my drawer, in case.
Vance has a bite on his hand. He says it is a dog.

defs.title: Scratched Inside the Vault Door
defs.author: R.C.
defs.body:
(Scratched into the paint with a key, low down:)
VANCE TURNED 9PM
DALE 2AM
I CAN'T REACH THE WHEEL FROM THE FLOOR
TELL MY SISTER

defs.title: Screening Team Brief
defs.author: Cordon Medical Authority
defs.body:
CORDON MEDICAL AUTHORITY - SCREENING TEAMS - NOT FOR DISTRIBUTION
Issued 14 April.
If residents ask, the approved answers are:
1. The illness is linked to a chemical release at the Corvane works. Shelter in place and it will pass.
2. Do not use the words FUNGUS, SPORE, MINE, CAVE or BLOOM in front of civilians.
3. Any person who has worked underground for Corvane since March is to be held on sight, whatever the thermometer says, and named by radio to Field Station 2.
4. The ground noise is seismic settling and harmless.

Okonkwo's pen in the margin: Issued in April. They closed the roads in September. Five months they knew what it was and wrote us what to say instead.
